shorts_extract.hook: Why 3rd-place Bronze winners smile wider than 2nd-place Silver winners — and how Leon Festinger's 1954 Social Comparison Theory explains modern envy.
shorts_extract.core_experiment: Festinger (1954 Human Relations, 9 hypotheses): fuzzy objective rulers to close-peer comparison + upward ability drive + 1995 Olympic 7.1 vs 4.8 proof.
shorts_extract.twist: Why distant billionaires don't sting while close classmates do, 150 villagers vs 10,000 highlight reels, and Lyubomirsky's Temporal Comparison cure.
